title: Brand mark · Accredited Program mark long name version
slide_intent: Show how a long place name can remain readable within a compact identifier. Giving it a deliberate line break preserves its relationship to the parent name.
strategic_value: The system can accommodate geographically specific names without asking local programs to shorten their identities.
demonstration: The St. Vincent & The Grenadines examples show stacked and single-line alternatives. A left column lists other program names exceeding 16 character spaces.
practical_value: When a program name exceeds 16 character spaces, choose the prepared long-name version and check its arrangement for the selected medium.

content_islands.name: Threshold and names
content_islands.spec: Place the character-count rule and a short set of qualifying names at left.

content_islands.name: Print adaptations
content_islands.spec: Use one long name across two-line, single-line and centered marks so its wrapping can be compared.

content_islands.spec: Place the symbol-first lockup below the online band. Retain the local name beneath the logotype.
